content.short: Altitude is a self-custodial business account for teams running treasury, cards and payments on stablecoins.
content.description: Altitude is a finance platform for companies that would rather keep working capital in stablecoins than in a traditional bank account. Teams hold balances in USD, EUR, GBP, MXN and BRL and move money over ACH, SEPA, wire and SWIFT or directly onchain, which suits exporters and remote first companies paying suppliers across borders. Physical and virtual cards come with spend policies and expense tracking, and the platform handles invoicing, payables, receivables and accounting exports. It runs on Squads smart account infrastructure on Solana, so companies keep custody of their own funds.
content.meta: Altitude is a self-custodial business account for stablecoin treasury, cards and global payments. Discover Altitude on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
